name: Berkay Yazar
title: Actor · Improviser · Theatre-Maker
about: I have worked in independent theatre in Ankara since 2018. I am a founding member of Gri Şehir Tiyatrosu and Sisifos Sanat, where alongside acting I take on production, organisation and technical work such as lighting and sound operation. I practise physical theatre and improvisation, and work with Cosa Sahne on improvisation performances and workshop organisation. Working with limited resources has taught me to think of performance together with the practical labour that makes it possible.

items.title: Waiting for Waiting for Godot — Actor (Ester)
items.text: By Dave Hanson. A three-person meta-theatrical comedy about two actors endlessly waiting to rehearse Waiting for Godot. Alongside acting, I coordinated logistics and resources and designed an adaptable stage layout and technical rider for a touring-friendly setup with minimal equipment.

items.title: Kaktüslü Adam (The Man With The Cactus Plant) — Actor
items.text: Written and directed by Burak Efe Meyilli, an absurd play about unemployment and systemic pressure seen through a grotesque lens. I performed in the 2023 revival, interpreting the text through a distinct physical score and grotesque character makeup. The play's text received the "Best Playwright" award at the Direklerarası Audience Awards.

items.title: Kaktüslü Adam (The Man With The Cactus Plant) — Technical Lead
items.text: Technical lead for the production's original 2021 staging, responsible for production and technical operations. The play's text received the "Best Playwright" award at the Direklerarası Audience Awards.

items.title: Feryat (Bellow) — Lead Actor (Ceyhun)
items.meta: Short film, dir. Burak Efe Meyilli, 2021
items.text: An independent short film about a man's first day of losing his love and accepting his grief, balancing raw loss with an underlying absurdity.

items.title: Ah'lar Ağacı (The Tree of Ah's)
items.text: A dance- and choreography-driven production adapted from Didem Madak's poetry book. Production and organization, lighting operation and set installation.

items.title: Art
items.text: Assistant director, lighting and sound operator, and part of the stage design team (a mobile six-panel structure that rotates into a triangle).

items.title: The Beauty Queen of Leenane — Actor
items.text: The company's return to the stage after the pandemic and its most frequently performed production. Also responsible for installing key set components, including a working tap and plumbing system.

items.title: Dr. Jekyll & Mr. Hyde — Actor
items.text: The Turkish premiere. Ten distinct spaces created with four chairs, a coffee table, a trunk and a rotating door; sold-out audiences and touring before the pandemic ended the run.

items.title: Colonel Bird — Actor
items.text: The company's debut and first fully independent production.

items.title: Gri Şehir Tiyatrosu
items.text: Involved in Colonel Bird, Dr. Jekyll & Mr. Hyde, The Beauty Queen of Leenane and Ah'lar Ağacı.

items.title: Sisifos Sanat

items.title: Kırık Pot Doğaçlama
items.text: Short-form improvisation work and stage performances with Kırık Pot Doğaçlama.

items.title: DasDas Improvisation Festival

items.title: Technical theatre and production practice
items.text: Technical and production work carried out as a founding member of Gri Şehir Tiyatrosu and Sisifos Sanat, kept separate from the freelance credits below.

subsections.title: Freelance Technical Theatre
subsections.text: I work freelance in lighting realization, lighting operation and sound operation.

items.title: Cosa Sahne: Drama, Improvisation & Theatre Workshop
items.meta: July–September 2026 · Cosa Sahne · Eight-week programme · Acting techniques and theatre
items.text: Group theatre and improvisation exercises, acting and scene work.

items.title: Story, Dramaturgy & Writing
items.text: Four-module laboratory on narrative structure, dramaturgical analysis, metaphor-based writing and re-writing (the "Magnetic Field Method").

items.title: Meisner-based Acting
items.text: Listening, impulsive reaction, subtext and moment-to-moment presence through Meisner's repetition. Helped organise a follow-up workshop for Sisifos Sanat.

items.title: Laban Movement Analysis
items.text: Effort actions, spatial orientation, weight–time–flow dynamics and embodied character work.

items.title: Directing & Acting Workshop
items.text: Directing principles, actor–director communication, text interpretation and contemporary staging.

items.title: Producing for Theatre
items.text: Institutional identity, production planning, and international co-production models including touring and funding.

items.title: Ensemble-Based Devised Theatre
items.text: Ensemble creation through le jeu, improvisation and physical theatre, generating original material without a predetermined script.

items.title: Storytelling with Physical Theatre
items.text: Movement, silence, rhythm and physical play as narrative tools.

items.title: Michael Chekhov Technique
items.text: Psycho-physical approach: imagination, breath, movement, body centres, improvisation and ensemble play.

items.title: Physical Theatre & Clown
items.text: Lecoq-inspired work on naivete, playfulness, failure-as-impulse and non-verbal comedy.

items.title: Mask & Body — Commedia dell'Arte
items.text: Foundational mask work on body–rhythm–gesture relationships and physical improvisation.

items.title: Acting
items.practice: Acting in independent theatre productions and a short film.
items.training: Meisner-based acting, Michael Chekhov technique, self-tape / screen acting.

items.title: Improvisation
items.practice: Long-form and short-form improvisation practice; short-form stage performances.

items.title: Physical Theatre
items.training: Laban movement analysis, Lecoq-inspired physical theatre and clown, mask and body (Commedia dell'Arte), Viewpoints, gesture and mime, physical performance.

items.title: Collaborative Creation
items.practice: Collaborative creation in small independent groups; dramaturgical contribution in ensemble processes.
items.training: Ensemble-based devised theatre; story, dramaturgy and writing.

items.title: Technical Theatre
items.practice: Lighting and sound operation, lighting realization, technical and stage setup, technical riders.

items.title: Theatre Production
items.practice: Rehearsal coordination and production workflow; budget and resource coordination; festival and venue organisation; a custom spreadsheet system built for ticketing and box-office operations.

items.title: Workshop Facilitation
items.practice: Organisation and facilitation of the Cosa Sahne workshop; helped organise a follow-up workshop for Sisifos Sanat.

items.title: Languages
items.text: Turkish (native), English (B2, working proficiency; TOEFL iBT 87).
